title: Rishi Sunak - General Election Announcement in Torrential Rain
public_sentiment: Extensively mocked across social media and mainstream press as a PR disaster. Sunak stood soaked without an umbrella while protesters drowned out his voice with 'Things Can Only Get Better' ('Things can only get wetter'). Symbolized poor crisis management.

deductions_strict.explanation: Pause ratio of 16.3% is below the 20% oratorical law.
